      Initialize enrichment provider name, empty enrichment array, and observable value for URLHaus enrichment processing
    on-success:
    - Conditional_Parallel: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Enrichment_Provider
      value: URLHaus
    - name: Enrichment
      value: []
    - name: observable_value
      value:
        $:ref: $inputs.observable.observable_value
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 34a17766-18ef-4201-be64-50865c244239
    outputSchemaReferenceId: 3c361d23-d38b-4f0f-a9d2-bfcbe580d334

    type: parallelGroup
    description: >
      Execute parallel conditional branches to handle different observable types (URL, IP, domain, hash) simultaneously
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete:
    - NOOP: {}
    publish: {}
    entrypoints:
    - SHA256
    - IPDomain
    - Lookup_url
    - MD5
    actions:
      Create_TEDS_Error_Enrichment_for_Lookup_Hash:
        title: Create TEDS Error Enrichment for Lookup Hash
        type: connector
        description: >
          Generate TEDS error enrichment object when MD5 lookup fails
        on-success:
        - Update_Enrichment_Error_Hash: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        action: $playbook.component_aT0MBgT0PDhSCQjJu_playbook
        inputs:
          error_provider: '{ $:ref: $variables.Enrichment_Provider }'
          error_result: '{ $:ref: $actions.Lookup_MD5_Hash.result }'
          error_status: Error
        pool: $default
        testInputs: {}
        meta: {}
        delay: 0
        post: {}
        timeout: 0
        asset: ""
        environment: {}
        inputSchemaReferenceId: 492e251d-6e86-41cd-b50e-4b201eb89081
        outputSchemaReferenceId: 5d2e5687-a96b-4ce6-9f28-72cadb892d2c
      Create_TEDS_Enrichment_for_Lookup_URL:
        title: Create TEDS Enrichment for Lookup URL
        type: transformation
        description: >
          Transform URL lookup results into TEDS-compliant enrichment structure with verdict, timestamp, and raw data
        on-success:
        - Update_Enrichment_URL: {}
        on-failure: []
        on-complete: []
        publish: {}
        transformations:
          enrichment_verdict:
            title: Enrichment Verdict
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: "(\n  $query_status := actions.lookup_URL.result.json_body.**.query_status;\n  \n  \"ok\" in $query_status ? \"malicious\"\n  : \"no_results\" in $query_status ? \"unknown\"\n  : \"unknown\"\n)"
              data:
                actions:
                  lookup_URL:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        $:ref: $actions.lookup_URL.result.json_body
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_timestamp
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment_timestamp:
            title: Enrichment Timestamp
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: '($lastOnline := actions.lookup_URL.result.json_body.**.last_online; $exists($lastOnline) ? $lastOnline : $now())'
              data:
                actions:
                  lookup_URL:
                    result:
                      json_body:
                        $:ref: $actions.lookup_URL.result.json_body
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_permalink
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment_permalink:
            title: Enrichment Permalink
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: '""'
              data: {}
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment_context
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment_context:
            title: Enrichment Context
            description: ""
            display:
              functions: []
              advancedView: true
            inputs:
              expression: '""'
              data: {}
            actionType: jsonata
            next: enrichment
            timeout: 0
            meta: {}
          enrichment:

            description: ""

            inputs:

                    "enrichment_type": "reputation",

                    "enrichment_timestamp": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment_for_Lookup_URL.result.enrichment_timestamp,
                    "enrichment_permalink": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment_for_Lookup_URL.result.enrichment_permalink,
                    "enrichment_context": actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment_for_Lookup_URL.result.enrichment_context,

                      enrichment_timestamp:

                      enrichment_permalink:
                        $:ref: $actions.Create_TEDS_Enrichment_for_Lookup_URL.result.enrichment_permalink
                      enrichment_context:

                variables:

            actionType: jsonata
            next: ""
            timeout: 0
